REMARKS:
171500Z POSITION NEAR 12.7N 145.5E.
17OCT26. TYPHOON 29W (CHAMPI), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 96 NM
SOUTHEAST OF ANDERSEN AFB, HAS TRACKED WESTWARD AT 12 KNOTS OVER
THE PAST SIX HOURS. MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE AT 171200Z IS 945 MB. 
MAXIMUMS IGNIFICANT WAVE HEIGHT AT 171200Z IS 42 FEET. NEXT WARNINGS 
AT 172100Z, 180300Z, 180900Z AND 181500Z.//
